messages:
avery: Dropped a tiny walkthrough of the proposed IA flip: three primary groups + utility rail. Focus here is deep-link stability and breadcrumb behavior. Figma: https://figma.com/file/unique-nav Walkthrough doc: /docs/nav-walkthrough.md :eyes:

lucas: looked. I like the simplified labels. Two quick concerns: (1) external bookmarks to /console/models/:id/versions, (2) ephemeral hash links we used in some marketing. How do we canonicalize?

ira: proposal: canonical server 301s for public/permanent routes + client-side normalize for everything else. Also return header `X-Nav-Deprecated: /console/models/:id/versions` on redirect so we can signal deprecation in telemetry.

marta: accessibility notes: when collapsing a group, move focus to the group button and set `aria-expanded`. Announce state via `aria-live="polite"`. Keep the visual chevron >=44px hit target and bump stroke for contrast.

nav-bot: [a11y-check] reported: chevron contrast 3.5:1 on accent bg; recommended thicker stroke or adjust color to #eff1f3 to reach 4.5:1 for small icons. Missing aria-label on utility rail toggle.

lucas: breadcrumbs: prefer slash separators and stable root crumb (e.g., always show "Models / MyModel / Versions"). Truncation rules: keep first + last visible, ellipsize center. Tooltip on hover for truncated crumbs. Can we A/B test slash vs chevron?

avery: yes — add A/B plan. Metrics: breadcrumb_click_rate, time_to_first_action, nav_abandonment. Start 3% rollout.

ira: routing helper (client-side canonicalize) example: 
```
function canonicalizeIncoming(href){
  const url = new URL(href, location.origin)
  let path = url.pathname !== '/' ? url.pathname : url.hash.replace('#','')
  path = stripLegacyFragments(path) // drops old view segments like /versions
  const view = mapLegacyViewToQuery(path) // e.g. /versions -> ?tab=versions
  return { path: normalize(path), query: view ? { tab: view } : {} }
}
```
Use before router.resolve so we can either push a clean URL or let server 301 handle it.

marta: keyboard shortcut idea: `g` then `d` -> jump to Deployments, `g` then `m` -> Models. Ensure focus lands on the first actionable node. Add to keyboard-nav doc.

violet: microcopy: shorten crumbs to plural root ("Models / Foo") and use sentence-case for items. Keep breadcrumb separators aria-hidden and active crumb aria-current=\"page\".

avery: edge-case: if both server and client mappings exist, prefer server 301 (preserves SEO). Client fallback only when server returns 404 or no mapping. Add priority list to RFC: 1) exact path, 2) server rewrite/301, 3) client canonicalize -> query, 4) hash fallback, 5) global search fallback.

lucas: actionables: (1) Ira to draft canonicalize helper + sample client snippet (owner: ira, due: Tue), (2) Marta to add keyboard + aria checklist and update figma contrast (owner: marta, due: Tue), (3) Lucas to write A/B test spec + telemetry events (owner: lucas, due: Wed), (4) Avery to add `X-Nav-Deprecated` header recommendation to RFC and add redirect mapping template (owner: avery, due: Wed).

marta: small UX nit: show subtle unread badge count on collapsed groups, keep it visually minimal.

avery: great. I'll update the walkthrough and push a new prototype with contrast, focus fixes, and the breadcrumb truncation behavior. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
